data-model/append-only-audit-log-table.body: Problem: no record of who changed what. Solution: audit_logs(actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, before jsonb, after jsonb, ip, created_at), insert-only, written by services for admin and sensitive actions. Use when: any admin panel. Avoid when: high-volume telemetry (use a log pipeline).
data-model/append-only-audit-log-table.title: Append-only audit log table

data-model/capacity-and-stock-protected-.body: Problem: overbooking and overselling under concurrent requests. Solution: inside one transaction SELECT the parent row FOR UPDATE (or UPDATE ... SET sold = sold + 1 WHERE sold < capacity) plus a unique constraint for once-only actions. Use when: tickets, seats, tables, stock. Avoid when: counts that may go over (analytics).
data-model/capacity-and-stock-protected-.title: Capacity and stock protected by row lock or conditional update

data-model/money-as-integer-minor-units-.body: Problem: floating point rounding errors in totals. Solution: amount_minor bigint + currency char(3); compute totals on the server only. Use when: anything with prices. Avoid when: never.
data-model/money-as-integer-minor-units-.title: Money as integer minor units with currency code

data-model/status-state-machine-with-all.body: Problem: records jump to invalid states (confirmed without payment). Solution: enum status column + a transitions map enforced in the service, with tests for every illegal jump. Use when: orders, bookings, approvals, events. Avoid when: simple on/off flags.
data-model/status-state-machine-with-all.title: Status state machine with allowed transitions

data-model/users-roles-and-record-owners.body: Problem: role panels (admin, organizer, staff) leak data across users. Solution: users, roles, user_roles tables plus owner_id on every owned record; guard checks role, service checks owner_id = user or admin. Use when: any multi-role panel. Avoid when: single-user tools.
data-model/users-roles-and-record-owners.title: Users, roles and record ownership (RBAC + owner_id)

data-model/uuid-v7-keys-timestamptz-soft.body: Problem: guessable IDs and inconsistent timestamps. Solution: UUID v7 primary keys, created_at/updated_at timestamptz in UTC, deleted_at only where recovery is needed. Use when: default for every table. Avoid when: a table needs natural keys.
data-model/uuid-v7-keys-timestamptz-soft.title: UUID v7 keys, timestamptz, soft delete only where needed

process/serialize-schema-changes-paralle.body: Problem: parallel agents create conflicting migrations. Solution: schema and shared-package changes on main one at a time; independent features in .worktrees/ branches; smallest diff merges first. Use when: several agents in one project. Avoid when: a single agent.
process/serialize-schema-changes-paralle.title: Serialize schema changes, parallelize features in worktrees

security/refresh-token-rotation-with-reu.body: Problem: stolen refresh tokens give long-lived access. Solution: short access token, refresh token stored hashed with a family id; each refresh rotates; reuse of an old token revokes the whole family. Use when: token auth for web or mobile. Avoid when: plain server sessions are enough.
security/refresh-token-rotation-with-reu.title: Refresh token rotation with reuse detection

security/tiered-redis-rate-limits-with-t.body: Problem: brute force, scraping and spam. Solution: Redis sliding-window tiers (global, auth, sensitive, expensive, write), client IP from trusted proxies only, escalating temporary ban set after repeated 429s or failed CAPTCHAs. Use when: every public app. Avoid when: never.
security/tiered-redis-rate-limits-with-t.title: Tiered Redis rate limits with temporary IP ban

stack/web-default-next-js-nestjs-postgre.body: Problem: choosing a stack for multi-role web panels. Solution: Next.js frontend, NestJS API, PostgreSQL with Prisma, Redis; monorepo with pnpm and Turborepo. Use when: web apps with several role panels or a mobile client. Avoid when: tiny single-page tools (Next.js full-stack is simpler). Versions must be re-checked live.
stack/web-default-next-js-nestjs-postgre.title: Web default: Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL + Prisma + Redis
